host.name: oki (srv1714035)
host.note: Production host. Measured directly over SSH (alias `oki`).

workload.book: tel / 30 pages / 21 MB scan, 1280x720 pt pages

core_essential.postgres: pgvector/pg16 - books, pages, jobs, stage status
core_essential.redis: Celery broker + result backend + SSE pub/sub + rate limiting
core_essential.ollama: LLM inference (model resident only while in use)
core_essential.worker: Celery; runs Tesseract as a subprocess (no separate OCR service)

core_adjacent_keep_on.backup: daily pg_dump, 7-day retention; idle sleep loop, ~12 MiB. Sole automated backup of pgdata.

measured_idle_memory_mib.note: Ollama idle at 155 MiB means the model is UNLOADED (ollama ps empty) - an idle snapshot understates peak.

measured_core_only_stack_mib.note: Gating validated by starting only core services; nothing core depends on the optional ones.

ocr_phase.note: Worker peak CPU 335% => Tesseract OpenMP already uses ~3.35 of 4 cores for a single page; pages are sequential.

extraction_phase.post_hang: job sat at running 100% - see learnings/016 (persistence deadlock); no llm_runs/metadata rows written

host_memory_under_load.note: 1s /proc/meminfo sampling over the whole extraction (1720 samples). AnonPages matches the container sum, so host memory is fully attributed. No 10 GB transient exists.

superseded_measurement_artifact.claim: host 'used' spiked to 11733-12440 MiB in two runs
superseded_measurement_artifact.cause: aggregate `free -m` used sampled via subprocess at 2-4s intervals, which cannot distinguish AnonPages / Cached / Shmem / Slab
superseded_measurement_artifact.disproof: 1-second /proc/meminfo category sampling across the same phases shows anon <= 7713 MiB and no sample with anon>9GB, cached>9GB or shmem>1GB

phase_split.note: Extraction dominates per-book wall-clock ~4.3x, so LLM tuning is the larger lever than OCR page-parallelism.
